description: LiveKit Agents in text mode: one AgentSession with a get_weather function tool, the OpenAI plugin on the mock, and the framework's own telemetry (content kept).
notes: livekit-agents 1.8.12 and livekit-plugins-openai 1.8.12 in envs/livekit (its own environment: the capture project's beeai pins json-repair below 0.61, and livekit needs 0.63.5, D-IN-26 item 1). No room, no audio: session.run(user_input=...) in text mode. set_tracer_provider(provider, allow_pii=True) keeps the lk.pii.* content. The model is openai.LLM with an openai.AsyncClient whose base URL is https://api.openai.com/v1 and whose transport reaches the mock under that real host (D-IN-3, RealHostAsyncTransport), so the plugin's provider is api.openai.com and the cost is priced. The turns carry that host, which the mock checks. Expected: agent_session chain, start_agent_activity span, agent_turn agent, llm_node chain, llm_request llm, llm_request_run span, function_tool tool, and a second llm_node and llm_request for the answer after the tool. Volatile: the speech and generation ids (LiveKit mints them per run, also on the generation events), and lk.pii.chat_ctx and lk.pii.response.function_calls, whose item ids are random per run (the chat context is therefore replaced by a placeholder in the fixture). Timing: the TTFT and queue-wait values and lk.llm_metrics. The completion start time is an instant (timestamp_attributes).

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
